title: Zen Kaku Gothic New
description: A square gothic with a straight skeleton. It is in the same Zen family as Zen Maru Gothic, with the roundness cut away for a tidy tone. Six weights from Thin to Black. It takes extrusion, bevel, and metal materials well, so it is the default for 3D text (texts[] flat and extrude). Today this is an index only. Each 3D text asset bundles its own binary. Promoting it on the catalog/font side is a separate decision.
when_to_use: The default face for 3D text (a tube layout, an extruded hero title, and similar). Also for any heading or title card that needs a straight geometric square gothic
ai_usage: 3D テキスト素材（texts[].font）の既定ウェイトは Black（900）。見出し・タイトル用途では Bold〜Black、本文寄りの字幕には Regular〜Medium を使う想定。字間・行間・カラーは overlay/テロップ側で調整してよいが、グリフ形状そのもの（フォントファイル）は改変しない
